narratives.Overview:
# Reversible closed-entry archive for `.deft-cache` (triage hygiene)

**Status:** Implement-ready after **2026-08-05 freshen** against master (~v0.95). Standalone enhancement (reparented off closed #1119).

## Problem

Closed GitHub issues can linger forever under the live unified cache, inflating walkers (`triage:queue`, scope-drift, bootstrap). Operators need an **explicit, reversible** “move to archive” hygiene pass — not silent data loss.

## Current shape on master (critical: do not confuse surfaces)

| Surface | Reality |
| --- | --- |
| Live issue cache | **`.deft-cache/github-issue/<owner>/<repo>/<N>/`** with `raw.json`, `content.md`, `meta.json` (#883) |
| Existing **`task cache:prune`** | **TTL / `expires_at` hard-delete** via `cachePrune` in `packages/core/src/cache/operations.ts` — **not** reversible; **not** “closed-and-terminal” |
| Triage audit | **`xbrief/.triage-cache/candidates.jsonl`** (decisions: accept/reject/defer/needs-ac/mark-duplicate/… — **no `done` decision**) |
| Default prune window constant | `DEFAULT_PRUNE_OLDER_THAN_DAYS = 30` already exists for **TTL** prune — archive window may reuse 30d but must document distinction |

**This issue does not replace `cache:prune`.** It adds a **separate** reversible archive workflow for **closed** issue entries the operator wants off the live tree.

## Scope

### A. Archive storage layout

```text
.deft-cache/archived/github-issue/<owner>/<repo>/<N>/
  raw.json
  content.md
  meta.json
  archive-meta.json    # archived_at, reason, pre_archive_decision?, source_path
```

Containment: same projection rules as live cache writes (`assertWritableCachePath` / project-root containment #2470 / #3042 class).

### B. `task triage:cache-archive` (name bikeshed OK; document final)

Operator-invoked only. **Never** wire into `task check`, session-start, or sync hooks in v1.

**Eligibility (freshened — no fictional `done` decision):**

Include an entry when **all** hold:

1. Live path exists under `.deft-cache/github-issue/<owner>/<repo>/<N>/`
2. `raw.json.state == "closed"` (GitHub issue state)
3. **Age:** `closed_at` (from raw) or, if missing, `meta.fetched_at` / mtime — older than `--older-than-days` (default **30**)
4. **Not** referenced by an open lifecycle scope in `xbrief/{proposed,pending,active}/` whose origin is issue N (refuse or skip with reason — prefer **skip + report**, not half-move)

Optional tighten (flag `--terminal-decision-only`):

- Latest candidates decision ∈ {`reject`, `mark-duplicate`} **or** no accept still “in flight” — implementer documents default as **closed+age** only so completed-and-accepted closed issues can archive too.

**Actions:**

- Move (rename) entry dir live → archived
- Write `archive-meta.json` + append a **triage/cache audit** line (either candidates-adjacent event or cache quarantine-audit — pick one and document; prefer structured append that `triage:show` / archive-list can read)

**Flags:**

- `--dry-run`
- `--older-than-days N`
- `--repo owner/name` (limit)
- `--source github-issue` (v1 only; forward-compatible)
- `--json` summary

**Suggested task name** (avoid collision):

- `task triage:cache-archive` **or** `task cache:archive-closed`  
  **Do not** overload `task cache:prune` (TTL destroy).

### C. `task triage:archive-list` (or `cache:archive-list`)

List `.deft-cache/archived/github-issue/...`, newest `archived_at` first.

Flags: `--since`, `--repo`, `--format=json`, `--limit`.

### D. `task triage:restore-from-archive --issue N [--repo …]`

Move archived entry back to live key path. Idempotent no-op if already live. Refuse if live path already exists with different content (force flag optional).

### E. Skill / docs

- `deft-directive-triage` hygiene section: quarterly archive-closed vs TTL `cache:prune`
- One-line distinction table in skill or `commands.md`

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Archive path layout under `.deft-cache/archived/github-issue/...`
- [ ] Operator-only archive command; dry-run; default 30d closed age; skips in-flight scopes
- [ ] List + restore + idempotent restore
- [ ] **Documented non-overlap** with `task cache:prune` (TTL hard-delete)
- [ ] Tests: dry-run, archive, list, restore, skip open-scope, missing entry
- [ ] CHANGELOG `[Unreleased]`
- [ ] TS engine implementation (`packages/core/src/cache` and/or `triage/*` + task wire)

## Demo

```text
task triage:cache-archive -- --dry-run
task triage:cache-archive -- --older-than-days 30
task triage:archive-list -- --format=json
task triage:restore-from-archive -- --issue 1234
task triage:show -- 1234   # works again from live cache
```

Contrast:

```text
task cache:prune -- --older-than-days 30   # TTL destroy; different tool
```

## Implementation pointers

- Live layout: `packages/core/src/cache/paths.ts`, `operations.ts`, `io.ts`
- Existing TTL prune: `cachePrune` — leave behavior; add sibling APIs
- Scope origin scan: ingest provenance helpers (skip if N still in proposed/pending/active)
- Decisions (optional filter): `packages/core/src/triage/actions/candidates-log.ts`
- Tasks: `tasks/cache.yml` and/or new `tasks/triage-*.yml` + root aliases

## Not in scope

- Auto-archive on bootstrap/sync
- GC of `archived/` (manual only v1)
- Compression
- Changing TTL `cache:prune` semantics
- Non-github-issue sources (unless free with ALLOWED_SOURCES loop)

## Refs

- Historical parent: #1119 § pruning (closed); this issue standalone (was D19)
- Cache foundation: #883
- Related existing: `task cache:prune`, `cache:invalidate`

## Freshen log

| Date | Change |
| --- | --- |
| 2026-08-05 | Separate from TTL `cache:prune`; fix paths; drop invalid `done` decision; closed+age eligibility; skip in-flight scopes; xbrief triage-cache; TS pointers; reparent |

---

## Issue comment thread

_The issue body is the original write-up; maintainer comments below may supersede it. Read the full thread before building a dispatch envelope (#2143)._

### Comment by @MScottAdams (2026-08-06T00:10:53Z)

## Reparent off #1119 (residual-check 2026-08-05)

#1119 closed **completed**. This issue (D19 archive verbs) was **optional hygiene**, not required for “what next?” architecture.

- **Not implemented** yet (no `triage:audit:prune` / archive-list / restore).
- **Still valid** as standalone enhancement for reversible closed-entry prune.
- **Not** 1.0 Must. Keep open; prioritize if `.deft-cache` closed clutter becomes operator pain.

### Comment by @MScottAdams (2026-08-06T00:19:35Z)

## Freshen complete (2026-08-05)

Body rewritten against current master. **Implement-ready.**

Key correction: existing **`task cache:prune`** is TTL **hard-delete**. This issue is a **separate reversible archive** for **closed** `github-issue` entries. Do not overload prune.
